profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Liquid Robotics
profile.summary: Can't learn much if it isn't broken.

positions.title: Software Engineer | FishTools
positions.description:
 Design and develop web application user interfaces leveraging open source technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and JSON
 Implement server side control systems using Java, Spring, and Tomcat with transports through Spring Integration, Java Remote Method Invocation (RMI), and Java Message Service (JMS)
 Design and implement an access control system to manage permission for different user group data
 Develop interfaces to manage data stored in Oracle and MongoDB
 Capture user requirements and deliver features on a regular periodic schedule
 Exercise Agile software development processes to manage tasks and track changes to the software product
 Utilize Git, Gradle, and Jenkins to assist with building and deployment to target platforms

positions.title: Software Engineer | P-8 Acoustic Submarine Warfare
positions.description:
 Worked in a team to design and develop an OSGi compliant Acoustic System Framework (ASF) using Java, Maven, Subversion, and Jenkins to extend existing acoustic capabilities to allow third party development and integration of new services and algorithms
 Wrapped a proprietary legacy transport protocol written in C++ with Java Native Interface (JNI) for reuse in Java JVM environment to drastically increase performance for real time signal processing
 Developed and presented an add-on user interface by leveraging Leap Motion technology to enhance acoustic operator experience while reducing workflow for anti-submarine warfare
 Added the ability to playback raw acoustic data at faster than real-time speeds to the current scenario replay system and successfully demonstrated capability to customers
 Led team in designing, developing, and integrating a third party detection algorithm using ASF and developed risk reductions tools to validate the algorithm and extract performance metrics
 Pioneered and consulted on methodology and tools for processing recorded mission data from a legacy system during previous test flights for playback with Boeing’s acoustic system
 Transformed MATLAB algorithms into C++ and Java for deployment on the target platform for use with currently fielded systems. Utilized opened sourced linear algebra libraries and Boost bindings to reduce code complexity and simplify function calls

positions.title: Network Systems Engineer | Brigade Combat Team Modernization & Ground Mobile Radio
positions.description:
 Designed and orchestrated field tests using vendor provided radios and antennas to develop tactical solutions to the customers 
 Analyzed software defined radio waveforms for soldier wearable systems, small unmanned ground vehicles (SUGV), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), and tactical and urban unattended ground sensors (T-UGS/U-UGS)
 Designed robust network topologies integrating many of the mobile ad hoc networks
 Wrote procedures to train field engineers and soldiers to operate many of the critical systems
 Created BASH scripts used to analyze multicast protocols (IGMP and PIM) and performance
 Led the integration effort to install a software defined radio into an AH-64 Apache helicopter
 Analyzed Negative-ACKnowledgment (NACK) Oriented Reliable Multicast (NORM) implemented by several vendors for correctness and effectiveness in lossy mobile ad-hoc networks
 Assisted with installation, integration, and testing of Boeing’s Network Integration Kit (NIK) into Mine Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) vehicles for evaluation by soldiers
 Developed, configured, and maintained test systems used in lab and field test
 Configured racoon, an open source Internet Key Exchange (IKE) key management daemon to establish IPSEC tunnels between network devices for secure encrypted data channels
 Provided consultation and solutions to issues observed at multiple Army Network Integration Evaluation (NIE) field tests

positions.title: Associate Project Manager
positions.description:
• Tested, validated, and developed resolutions for voice over IP (VoIP) technology using
Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Media Gateway Control Protocol (MGCP) protocols
incorporated in commercial Internet Gateway Devices (IGD)
• Developed automated test suites in Linux to verify compliance of industry standards defined in RFCs. Debugged routing protocols (RIP, OSPF), VPN (IPSec, L2TP), and other network
protocols using various open source tools
• Supported development of future business and interfaced with other engineers to evolve new
projects
